status_note: A summary written for ELI Legal, in its own words. It is not the text of the instrument and has not been validated by a qualified lawyer. Check the official text before relying on any statement in it.
title: Right to be heard (Germany)
description: The constitutional right to be heard, the court's duty to point out what the parties have overlooked, and equal treatment in arbitration.

requirements.title: No surprise decisions
requirements.text: A court may base its decision on a point a party has evidently overlooked or thought irrelevant only after pointing it out and giving the opportunity to comment.
requirements.statement: Before I rely on a legal point or authority the parties have not addressed, I will point it out to them and give them the opportunity to comment.

requirements.title: Equal treatment in arbitration
requirements.text: The parties are treated equally and each is given the right to be heard.
requirements.instruction: Set out each party's position with equal care and completeness.
